subject: Security review playbook & SOC 2 package — next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@clearwaterbank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security review playbook & SOC 2 package — next steps

Hi Asha — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones for the security/SOC 2 portion so we have alignment and owners. Attached: redwood_map_playbook_v0.2.xlsx (draft).

High-level MAP milestones (first pass):
- Kickoff & discovery session
  - Target: 2026-07-07
  - Owner (Customer): Asha Kapoor (Clearwater)
  - Owner (Redwood): Marcus Lin
- SOC 2 questionnaire completion (customer-facing)
  - Target: 2026-07-14
  - Customer to complete their sections; Redwood will provide a pre-filled questionnaire and evidence guidance
- Evidence manifest & delivery
  - Redwood to provide a prioritized evidence list by 2026-07-09
  - Customer to upload requested artifacts or provide access by 2026-07-21
- Security signoff and final package handoff
  - Target close: 2026-08-04

Dependencies and notes:
- We need a named controls owner on your side for each evidence item (IAM, Logging, Backups, Change mgmt).
- Some evidence requires short-lived S3 links; Redwood can produce presigned URLs if you prefer uploads to our bucket.
- If procurement requires vendor paperwork (PO / contract redlines), please loop Procurement early — that can push the close date.

Asks: please confirm the named owners for the Kickoff and Evidence upload, and whether you prefer Redwood to host temporary upload links or for you to push artifacts into a shared drive. If those dates look off, tell us which ones to move and we’ll update the MAP.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_map_playbook_v0.2.xlsx (excel spreadsheet, MAP draft)

From: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@clearwaterbank.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Liu <ben.liu@clearwaterbank.com>, procurement@clearwaterbank.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 20:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Security review playbook & SOC 2 package — next steps

Thanks Diego — good recap. A few quick items from our side: 
- Can we shift the Evidence upload window later by one week? Our control owners are booked the week of 7/12. Proposed upload by 2026-07-28.
- Would you send a sample pre-filled SOC 2 questionnaire so our compliance team can review expected answers before we start filling?
- We prefer to upload artifacts to our secure SharePoint; however, if Redwood provides presigned S3 links we can discuss with security.

I’ll confirm a named controls owner by EOD Friday. Also looping in Ben (Engineering) and Procurement so they see the timeline.

Appreciate it — Asha
Asha Kapoor
Head of Compliance, Clearwater Bank
asha.kapoor@clearwaterbank.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@clearwaterbank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security review playbook & SOC 2 package — next steps

Thanks Asha — noted on the shift. I uploaded an updated MAP (redwood_map_playbook_v0.3.xlsx) and added a few artifacts to help your team: 
- soc2_questionnaire_blank.pdf (fillable PDF we use to speed reviews)
- evidence_template.csv (template we prefer for manifest uploads)

Quick updates based on your ask: 
- Evidence upload target moved to 2026-07-28 per your request.
- Redwood will produce a prioritized evidence manifest and an example sample answer set by 2026-07-09.
- We can support both workflows:
  - Option A: you upload to your SharePoint and send links;
  - Option B: we provide presigned S3 links and you upload into a temporary Redwood bucket (we'll delete after transfer).

Proposed owners (updated in v0.3):
- Kickoff & discovery: Asha (Customer PM) / Marcus (Redwood SE) — 2026-07-07
- Evidence manifest (Redwood owner): Marcus Lin — deliver by 2026-07-09
- Evidence upload (Customer owner): TBD (please confirm) — target 2026-07-28
- Final package delivery (Redwood): Neha Kapoor — target 2026-07-31

I also added a dependency row calling out Procurement/Contract signoff as a gating item for final handoff. HubSpot deal link included in the MAP. Can you confirm the controls owner and whether you want presigned links or SharePoint?

Best,
Diego

Attachments: redwood_map_playbook_v0.3.xlsx, soc2_questionnaire_blank.pdf, evidence_template.csv
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7426

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Evidence checklist + playbook tweaks

Diego — couple of notes before we send v0.3 to Asha's team: 
- I made a short evidence checklist (evidence_checklist_v1.csv) that maps our standard artifacts to Clearwater control owners (IAM, Logging, Backups, Change Mgmt).
- I'll propose a 60-minute security working session on 2026-07-08 10:00 PT to go through the questionnaire and evidence expectations — saves back-and-forth. Can you confirm and invite Asha/Ben?
- We should offer the presigned S3 links as the default for items like access logs and snapshots; SharePoint works for policy docs. Call out retention expectations in the MAP.

I'll own creating the presigned-link process and the manifest export. Neha — once you confirm final package contents we'll snapshot and send.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_checklist_v1.csv

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@clearwaterbank.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security review playbook & SOC 2 package — next steps

Hi Asha / Diego — confirmation from Redwood on deliverables and contents for the SOC 2 package: 
- SOC 2 questionnaire (pre-filled + blank PDF for your edits)
- Evidence manifest (CSV) mapping artifact -> control -> owner
- Example artifacts we will include where applicable:
  - IAM: user lists, role definitions, recent access reviews (redacted)
  - Logging: 30-day retention access logs, KVS rotational policy snapshot
  - Backups: backup policy + last successful backup snapshot
  - Change mgmt: selected change tickets and approval records
  - Incident mgmt: anonymized post-incident notes, incident timeline

I attached a short outline (soc2_evidence_package_outline.pdf) showing the folder structure and filenames we will use. We will provide presigned S3 links for large logs unless you prefer a transfer into SharePoint.

Next steps: please confirm (1) controls owners list, (2) upload method (SharePoint vs presigned links), and (3) availability for the 2026-07-08 working session. Once we have those, Marcus and I will lock dates and commit to the delivery windows in the MAP.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Product Security, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachment: soc2_evidence_package_outline.pdf
